# Requirements: Elmridge permit system RFP 2026-14

In the agency's words and numbering, with the page of its document. The panel decides.

## Mandatory
- M-1: The system must keep every permit record for seven years. (RFP, p. 4)
- M-2: The system must let applicants apply and pay online. (RFP, p. 4)
- M-3: The system must export every record in an open format. (RFP, p. 4)

## Desirable
- D-1: Inspectors can record visits from a phone. (RFP, p. 6)
- D-2: Applicants receive status updates by email. (RFP, p. 6)

## Evaluation criteria and method (as provided)
| Ref | Criterion | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| C-1 | Fit to the desirable requirements | 50 |
| C-2 | Implementation approach | 30 |
| C-3 | Price | 20 |
Mandatory requirements are evaluated pass/fail by the panel.
The panel will score each criterion from 0 to 5 and apply the weights.
Shortlisted bidders may be invited to present.
